$comment: Scribe tools (DRAFT v0.2). Each maps to a story patch operation in yarnotron-ha models/story.py. Tools record a PROPOSED action and return a provisional result; commit happens after the output review. 'class' is enforced in code.

tools.name: add_character
tools.description: Add a character the child introduced. Check the story state first; if a similar name exists, use update_character.

tools.name: add_scene
tools.description: Add a scene. If the child asked for a scene in words, call this directly. If you only think the narration deserves one, do not call this: ask the child first and call it only after their yes. draft_text, if given, must be the child's own words.

tools.name: add_fact
tools.description: Record a durable fact about the story world the child stated.

tools.name: undo_last_change
tools.description: Undo the last applied change. Use when the child asks to undo or go back; invent no other change.

tools.name: note_interest
tools.description: The child named something they love from outside the story. Use their words for it. Set ambiguous when you cannot tell story content from a liking.

tools.name: request_picture
tools.description: Create a pending picture request for a parent to approve. It never produces a picture by itself.

tools.name: add_tutor_note
tools.description: A short note for the parent dashboard (definition given, grammar help given). Never include personal details.

classes.auto: applied at commit if the output review passes
classes.confirm_unless_explicit: applied only if the child's utterance used an explicit edit word (change, rename, replace, update) or intent was an edit; otherwise held for the child's yes
classes.confirm: always held; the child's next utterance must be a clear yes before code applies it; a no discards it
classes.parent_approval: creates a pending media asset; only a parent can approve
classes.ask_unless_requested: applied at commit only if the child's utterance asked for a scene in words; otherwise held as a pending offer and applied by code on the child's next-turn yes
